description:
Job Title
 Software Engineering – Full Stack Developer – Advanced 
Role Overview
 We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise across both frontend and backend technologies, experience working with APIs and databases, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering teams.
Key Responsibilities
 
 Design, develop, test, and maintain end-to-end web applications.

 Build responsive and scalable frontend applications using modern JavaScript frameworks.

 Develop robust backend services, APIs, and microservices.

 Integrate frontend applications with RESTful/GraphQL APIs and third-party services.

 Design and optimize relational and NoSQL databases.

 Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code.

 Perform code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.

 Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application performance and production issues.

 Collaborate with Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, Architects, QA, and DevOps teams.

 Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions.

 Implement secure coding practices, authentication, authorization, and data protection.

 Support CI/CD, cloud deployments, monitoring, and production releases.

 Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance where required.

 Required Technical Skills
 
 Frontend: React.js / Angular / Vue.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3.

 Backend: Java / Python / Node.js / .NET or equivalent backend technology.

 Strong experience developing RESTful APIs and microservices .

 Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle.

 Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, or similar.

 Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns .

 Experience with Git and modern software development practices.

 Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

 Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP .

 Understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, and API security.

 Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and automated testing frameworks.

 Advanced-Level Expectations
 
 Ability to independently own complex features from requirements through production deployment.

 Strong understanding of system design, scalability, performance, and reliability .

 Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across frontend, backend, database, and infrastructure layers.

 Experience designing and implementing scalable microservices and distributed systems .

 Ability to evaluate technology choices and recommend appropriate solutions.

 Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.

 Ability to provide technical mentorship and influence engineering best practices.

 Preferred Skills
 
 Experience with Docker and Kubernetes .

 Exposure to event-driven architectures and messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.

 Experience with cloud-native application development.

 Knowledge of application observability, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.

 Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI application integration is a plus.

 Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

 Education & Experience
 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

 Typically 6–10+ years of professional software development experience , with significant hands-on Full Stack development experience.

 Key Competencies
 
 Full Stack Application Development

 Software Architecture & System Design

 API & Microservices Development

 Database Design & Optimization

 Cloud & DevOps

 Application Security

 Performance Optimization

 Problem Solving & Debugging

 Technical Leadership & Mentoring

 Agile Development & Cross-Functional Collaboration

 
  

 Compensation, Benefits and Duration 

 Minimum Compensation: USD 48,000

 Maximum Compensation: USD 168,000

 Compensation is based on actual experience and qualifications of the candidate. The above is a reasonable and a good faith estimate for the role.

 Medical, vision, and dental benefits, 401k retirement plan, variable pay/incentives, paid time off, and paid holidays are available for full-time employees.

 This position is available for independent contractors

 No applications will be considered if received more than 120 days after the date of this post.
